name: QWEN-LBAND-1
note: Mechanical projection of PRE-REG QWEN-LBAND-1. Bands frozen: linear-attn layers ascending split 16/16/16 -> early = vendor layers 0-20, mid = 21-41, late = 42-62; each +0.4296 GiB exactly. Six arms: bands from base B and from base F (F/L-redundancy-aware conditional leg). Recovery on the B->C axis. best/second = the two largest band recoveries from that base. FLOOR-BAR SEMANTICS, pinned: every *_floor_multiple metric is a RAW X-or-K gap in nats divided by the per-contrast f_X/f_K — never a recovery-fraction quantity; recovery-unit gaps report as separate observation fields (the refuted_if predicate reads the rec-unit gap and is the one rec-unit consumer). Floors per-contrast max.

BLe.description: B + C's S16 linear-attn payload, layers 0-20

BLm.description: B + C's S16 linear-attn payload, layers 21-41

BLl.description: B + C's S16 linear-attn payload, layers 42-62

FLe.description: F + C's S16 linear-attn payload, layers 0-20

FLm.description: F + C's S16 linear-attn payload, layers 21-41

FLl.description: F + C's S16 linear-attn payload, layers 42-62

bars.name: SANITY-BRACKET-CLEAN
bars.description: zero of the six arms' X/K outside [C_value - 5*floor, base_value + 5*floor] (base = B or F per arm)

bars.name: BAND-STRUCTURE-B-X
bars.description: (best band X recovery - second band) / f_X > 5 from base B: depth structure real

bars.name: CONDITIONING-X
bars.description: |dX(best B-band | F) - dX(same band | B)| / f_X > 5: the F repair changes what the band buys — cross-family interaction is depth-localized

bars.name: BAND-STRUCTURE-F-K
bars.description: K analogue from base F (completes the prose's 'K conjunct-analogues as separate bars' for both bases)

refuted_if: The flatness prior is refuted if BAND-STRUCTURE-B-X fires with the best band exceeding the second by more than 0.2 in rec_X units past the floor (predicate below reads the rec-unit gap; a fire under 0.2 rec units books structure-without-refutation).
registered_prior: House, weak throughout: flat-to-mild depth structure on X from base B (family probe measured codec homogeneity across depth); CONDITIONING-X fires (the measured 1.49 F/L redundancy has to live somewhere, and depth-localized overlap is the simplest home).
